integrity.mathematical_validity_scope: Exact finite complex and its 24 natural symmetries.
integrity.proof_basis: Exhaustive face-poset and matching computation combined with discrete Morse CW-homotopy theory and degree-zero attaching maps.

scientific_limitations: The proof and symmetry character concern only the completely bidirected five-vertex K_{2,3}; no all-parameter theorem is claimed.
The natural symmetry representation is decomposed over the rationals, not as an integral group lattice or an equivariant homotopy splitting.
